summary: Concrete MaterialDNA next-depth leaf: canonical project-key validation currently accepts '%' even though the validator's own declared stable-key alphabet is [a-z0-9._/-]. Tighten the regex by removing '%' and add a regression such as visual.familyKey='materials%2fcarpet' so URI-percent-style aliases cannot enter canonical MaterialDNA keys before persistence/Hero depth builds on them.
evidence: src/shared/Materials/MaterialDNA.luau validateProjectKey currently uses ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/%-]*$, which explicitly admits percent signs.
The immediately following validation diagnostic says accepted lowercase stable-key characters are [a-z0-9._/-], with no percent sign.

Docs/MATERIAL_DNA_CONTRACT.md defines these values as project-owned semantic keys and rejects direct URL/Roblox asset references; percent-encoded URI-like spellings are therefore unnecessary canonical surface area.

tests/materialdna_contract.luau covers direct rbxassetid:// rejection but has no percent-encoding regression; repository PR/lane search found no existing MaterialDNA percent/project-key-grammar repair lane.

Suggested bounded leaf acceptance: preserve all shipped fixture identities/fingerprints; reject '%' in every validateProjectKey-backed field; add explicit percent regression(s); no schema/version bump or new key framework unless existing canonical '%' keys are discovered during implementation.
